link.emailNotSent: Email delivery isn't set up, so nothing was sent. Copy the link and send it to {email} yourself, for example by text message or chat.

link.emailedOnlyHintNoDate: It works once. It goes only to that inbox — staff don't see the link.
link.notDeliveredBody: Nothing reached {email}. Try again in a few minutes, or ask the superadmin to create a link.
link.adminEmailOff: Only the superadmin can create invitation and password-reset links while email delivery is off.

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.description: Clinics and practices on the platform. Verify new ones, support existing ones and assign plans. Patients are shown as counts only.
orgs.searchPlaceholder: Name, email, city, registration no., owner…
orgs.caption: Organizations
orgs.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No organizations found} one {# organization found} other {# organizations found}}
orgs.emptyHint: Organizations appear here when a clinic signs up, or when you add one.
orgs.emptyFilteredHint: Try another status or a shorter search.

orgForm.title: Add an organization
orgForm.description: Use this when a clinic has signed a contract with you. We create the organization and give its owner a one-time invitation link.
orgForm.name: Organization name
orgForm.registrationNumberHint: The organization's state registration number, not a personal ID.
orgForm.ownerEmailHint: The owner receives the invitation. They run the organization and have patient access.
orgForm.startActiveHint: You have already checked the organization, for example through a signed contract.
orgForm.startPendingHint: Patient records stay closed until someone verifies it.
orgForm.planHint: You can change it later on the organization's page.
orgForm.successBody: {name} is ready. Send the owner their invitation link.
orgForm.successStep1: The owner opens the link and creates their account, or signs in with one they already have.
orgForm.successStep2: The link works once, for 7 days, and is shown only now.
orgForm.successStep3: If it gets lost, create a new link on the organization's page under Invitations.

errors.name: Enter at least 2 characters.
errors.email: Enter a valid email address or leave it empty.

pendingCallout.title: Waiting for verification
pendingCallout.body: Members can complete the profile and invite colleagues, but patient records stay closed until you verify the organization.

suspendedCallout.title: Suspended on {date}
suspendedCallout.body: Patient records and organization management are blocked. Nothing is deleted.

verify.title: Verify {name}?
verify.description: Verification confirms that this is a real medical organization.
verify.unlocks: Once verified, its owners and practitioners (with 2-step sign-in) can register patients and record intakes.
verify.checkRegistry: I checked registration number {number} in the state registry.
verify.checkRegistryMissing: There is no registration number on file — I confirmed the organization's legal registration another way.
verify.checkPhone: I called the organization at {phone} and spoke with someone there.
verify.checkPhoneMissing: There is no phone on file — I contacted the organization through an official channel.
verify.checkOwnerMissing: I confirmed who will own and run this organization.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.description: Patient records and organization management are blocked right away, until you reactivate it. Members see the reason you write below. Nothing is deleted.
suspend.reasonPlaceholder: For example: The contract has ended. Please contact us.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.description: Members get access back right away, including patient records for practitioners with 2-step sign-in.
reactivate.descriptionUnverified: Members get access back right away. The organization was never verified, so reactivating it also marks it as verified.

edit.title: Edit organization profile
edit.description: Correct the details the organization gave us. Members see the changes right away.
edit.changed: {count, plural, one {# field changed.} other {# fields changed.}}
edit.clearHint: Empty an optional field to remove it.

plan.title: Plan and usage
plan.countsOnly: Counts only. Staff never see the records themselves.

members.title: Members
members.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}} · {clinical} with patient access
members.empty: No members yet. The owner joins by accepting the invitation below.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Recent audit log entries for this organization.

delete.summary: Deletes the organization with {patients, plural, one {# patient} other {# patients}} and {intakes, plural, one {# intake} other {# intakes}}. This can't be undone.
delete.title: Delete {name} permanently?
delete.description: This deletes the organization, its {members, plural, one {# membership} other {# memberships}}, all {patients, plural, one {# patient} other {# patients}} with their clinical records ({intakes, plural, one {# intake} other {# intakes}}), its invitations and its plan. Members keep their personal accounts.
delete.irreversible: Deleted records can't be restored. If the organization still needs its records, ask its owner to save them first.

planAssign.title: Change plan: {name}
planAssign.description: Payments aren't connected yet, so record how the plan was agreed in the note.
planAssign.useDefaultHint: Removes the assigned plan. The platform's default plan applies, also when the default changes later.
planAssign.noteHint: For example: Contract No. 12, paid by bank transfer.
planAssign.periodEndHint: For your records. Access doesn't stop automatically on this date.
planAssign.removed: Assigned plan removed. The default plan applies.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Tiers for individuals and organizations, with their limits.
plans.assignedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Not assigned} one {Assigned to #} other {Assigned to #}}
plans.how1: Payments are not connected yet: prices are for information only.
plans.how2: Plans are assigned on an organization's or a user's page.
plans.how3: The default plan is what everyone without an assigned plan gets.
plans.how4: Plans are never deleted. Deactivate a plan to stop new assignments; existing ones keep working.
plans.readOnly: Only the superadmin can create or edit plans. You can assign plans on organization and user pages.
plans.individualsHint: Personal accounts: limits on own and family profiles.
plans.organizationsHint: Clinics and practices: limits on practitioners and patients.

planForm.createDescription: Plans can't be deleted later, only deactivated. Check the code before you create it.
planForm.editDescription: Code {code} · {audience}. Changes apply right away to everyone on this plan.
planForm.codeHint: Capital letters, digits and _ (for example ORG_PLUS). It can't be changed later.
planForm.audienceIndividualHint: Personal accounts and their family profiles.
planForm.priceHint: Whole tugriks. Leave empty for free or by agreement.
planForm.limitsHint: Limits apply right away. Accounts already over a new limit keep their data but can't add more.
planForm.pdfReportsHint: Practitioners can export intakes as PDF.
planForm.makeDefaultHint: Everyone without an assigned plan moves to this plan. The current default plan stops being the default.
planForm.isDefaultNote: This is the default plan ({audience}). To change the default, make another plan the default.
planForm.activeHint: Inactive plans can't be newly assigned; existing assignments keep working.
planForm.activeDefaultHint: The default plan is always active.

errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.price: Enter a whole number of tugriks, or leave it empty.
errors.limit: Enter a whole number, or tick Unlimited.
errors.sortOrder: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10,000.

inviteActions.renewBody: A new link for {email} replaces the old one, which stops working. The new link works for 7 days.
inviteActions.renewBodyEmailed: We email a new link to {email}. It replaces the old one, which stops working, and works for 7 days. You won't see the link yourself.
inviteActions.revokeBody: The link sent to {email} stops working right away. You can create a new link later.
inviteActions.linkBody: Send this link to the person. They open it to create their account, or to join with the account they already have.

invites.title: Invitations
invites.description: Invitations to platform staff and to organizations, across the platform.
invites.howLinksWork: Invitation links are shown only once, when they are created. If someone lost theirs, create a new link — the old one stops working.
invites.howLinksWorkEmailed: New invitation links are emailed straight to the person. For security, only the superadmin sees the links themselves. Creating a new link stops the old one.
invites.caption: Invitations
invites.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No invitations found} one {# invitation found} other {# invitations found}}
invites.emptyHint: Invitations appear when organizations invite members or a new organization is added.
invites.emptyHintSuperadmin: Invite a platform admin, or add an organization to invite its owner.

staffInvite.title: Invite a platform admin
staffInvite.description: Platform admins help run the control center. Invite only people you trust: they can act on every organization and account.
staffInvite.emailHint: The invitation works for 7 days. They must turn on 2-step sign-in before they can use the control center.

users.title: Users
users.description: Every account on the platform: individuals, organization members and staff. Account data only — no health records.
users.caption: Users
users.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No users found} one {# user found} other {# users found}}
users.emptyHint: Accounts appear here as people sign up or accept invitations.
users.emptyFilteredHint: Try other filters or a shorter search.

blocked.selfBody: Manage your own account in Settings: password, 2-step sign-in and sessions.
blocked.superadminBody: Nobody can change or delete the superadmin account from the control center. Its owner manages it in Settings.
blocked.staffTitle: Staff accounts are managed by the superadmin
blocked.staffBody: Only the superadmin can reset, disable or change another staff member's account.

account.title: Account
account.mfaOffRequired: Off — required, asked at the next sign-in
account.recoveryCodesLeft: {count, plural, =0 {None left} one {# left} other {# left}}

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.description: Where this person is a member.
orgs.empty: Not a member of any organization.

plan.title: Personal plan and usage
plan.countsOnly: Counts only. Staff never see the profiles or results themselves.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Recent audit log entries by or about this account.

actions.title: Account actions
actions.description: Each action asks for confirmation and is written to the audit log.

reset.summary: A one-time link to choose a new password, valid for 2 hours.
reset.title: Create a password reset link for {name}?
reset.description: The link lets the person choose a new password. It works once, for 2 hours, and older reset links stop working. If email is set up, it is also sent to {email}.
reset.verifyIdentity: Before you share the link, confirm it's really them — call them or meet in person. Anyone with the link can take over the account.
reset.linkBody: Share it with {name} through a trusted channel, after confirming their identity.
reset.summaryEmailed: Emails a one-time link to choose a new password, valid for 2 hours.
reset.descriptionEmailed: We email a one-time link to {email} so the person can choose a new password. It works once, for 2 hours, and older reset links stop working. You won't see the link yourself.
reset.emailOnlyNote: The link goes only to the account's email address. If the person can no longer open that mailbox, ask the superadmin.

signout.summary: Ends every session on all devices. The password stays the same.
signout.title: Sign {name} out everywhere?
signout.description: Every session ends within a minute, on all devices. Use this when a device was lost or the account may be at risk. The password doesn't change.

mfa.summary: For someone who lost their phone and their recovery codes.
mfa.title: Reset 2-step sign-in for {name}?
mfa.description: This removes their authenticator app and recovery codes and signs them out everywhere. At the next sign-in they set up 2-step sign-in again.
mfa.warningTitle: Account takeovers often start like this
mfa.warningBody: Only continue after confirming the person's identity by phone or in person — never based on an email or chat message alone.
mfa.check: I confirmed this person's identity by phone or in person.

disable.summary: Signs the person out and blocks sign-in until you enable the account again.
disable.title: Disable the account of {name}?
disable.description: They are signed out everywhere and can't sign in until you enable the account. Profiles, records and organization memberships stay as they are.
disable.reasonLabel: Reason (kept with the account and in the audit log)
disable.reasonPlaceholder: For example: Requested by the clinic owner.

enable.summary: Lets the person sign in again.
enable.title: Enable the account of {name}?
enable.description: They can sign in again with their current password.

role.promoteSummary: Gives access to the control center — never to health records.
role.promoteDescription: They are signed out now and must turn on 2-step sign-in at the next sign-in. Their own profiles and organization memberships stay.
role.demoteSummary: Back to a regular user account.
role.demoteDescription: They lose access to the control center right away and are signed out. Their personal account and organization memberships stay.
role.demoted: {name} is no longer a platform admin.
role.can2: Help people with their accounts: reset links, signing out, resetting 2-step sign-in
role.cannot1: Open patient records, intakes or BEDI results
role.cannot2: Change other staff or plans, or delete anything permanently
role.cannot3: Use the control center without 2-step sign-in

delete.title: Delete the account of {name} permanently?
delete.description: The account, its personal and family profiles and their BEDI history are deleted. Clinic records stay with their organizations. This can't be undone.
delete.blockedBody: This person is the only owner of these organizations, which still have other members. Another member must become an owner first:
delete.soleTitle: These organizations will be deleted too
delete.soleBody: This person is their only member, so the organizations and all their patient records are deleted with the account:
delete.clean: Personal profiles and BEDI history are deleted with the account. Clinic records stay with their organizations.
delete.alsoOrganizations: Also delete these organizations and their patient records
delete.alsoOrganizationsHint: Required. Without it the account can't be deleted.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what, when and from where. Use it to look into sign-in problems and changes.
audit.noHealthData: The audit log never contains health data: only ids, roles, counts and reasons typed by staff. The export uses the filters below (up to 10,000 rows).
audit.onlySuperadminTitle: Only the superadmin can open the audit log
audit.onlySuperadminBody: Ask the superadmin if you need to look into a security event.

filters.title: Filters
filters.rangeInvalid: The end date is before the start date.

results.title: Events
results.count: {count, plural, =0 {No events} one {# event} other {# events}}

audit.emptyFilteredHint: Widen the date range or clear a filter.

system.title: System
system.description: Configuration and health checks. Secret values are never shown.
system.onlySuperadminTitle: Only the superadmin can open system checks
system.onlySuperadminBody: System settings are managed by the platform owner.

summary.okBody: Configuration and data protection look healthy.
summary.issuesTitle: {count, plural, one {# item needs attention} other {# items need attention}}
summary.issuesBody: Follow the steps next to each item below.

encryption.title: Encryption key
encryption.ok: Set and valid. Sensitive fields are encrypted at rest.
encryption.missing: ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set. Encrypted fields (clinical notes, intake details, 2-step secrets) can't be read or saved.
encryption.invalid: ENCRYPTION_KEY is set but invalid: it must be 32 random bytes, base64-encoded.
encryption.fix: Set ENCRYPTION_KEY in Netlify → Site configuration → Environment variables, then deploy again. To create a key:
encryption.keepCopy: Keep a copy of the key in the password manager. Losing it means losing the encrypted data.

authSecret.title: Sign-in secret
authSecret.missing: AUTH_SECRET is missing. Set a long random value in the Netlify environment variables. Changing it later signs everyone out.

appUrl.title: App address
appUrl.ok: Links in invitations and emails use
appUrl.missing: APP_URL is not set, so links use the address of the current request. Set APP_URL to the public address, for example https://your-domain.

email.title: Email delivery
email.off: Not set up. Invitation and reset links are shown on screen once, and staff send them by hand.
email.howToEnable: To turn it on, set in Netlify:

database.title: Database
database.slow: That's slow: check the database provider's status.
database.down: Can't reach the database. Check DATABASE_URL and the provider's status.

security.title: Data protection
security.description: Encryption coverage, staff sign-in and the records kept.

plaintext.title: Unencrypted sensitive values
plaintext.unknown: Can't check until the encryption key is valid.
